title: The Late Charge Amount on Farm Real Estate Loans Installments: Unpaid Part, Percentage and Bounds
content:
The late charge on an installment of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage is the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid part of the installment at the end of the grace period, rounded to cents, and then held to no less than the product's minimum late charge and no more than its maximum late charge; it is assessed against the installment bill.

## Terms of the calculation

- **The installment.** The most recent installment bill — the contract-rate interest bill with the latest due date — whose installment amount is the loan's installment amount.
- **The grace period.** The product's late-charge grace days, counted in calendar days from the due date, the due date being day 0.
- **The unpaid part at the end of the grace period.** The installment amount less the interest paid on that installment when the most recent interest payment was received within the grace period (on or before the last grace day); when the most recent interest payment was received later, the unpaid part is the whole installment amount. The unpaid part is taken to cents.
- **The charge.** The unpaid part multiplied by the late-charge percentage, rounded to cents; if that is below the product's minimum late charge it is raised to the minimum, and if it is above the maximum it is held to the maximum.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

For these figures assume a product with a 15-day grace period, a 4.0 percent late-charge percentage, a USD 50 minimum and a USD 1500 maximum.

| Installment amount | Interest paid on the installment | Most recent interest payment received | Unpaid part | Percentage applied | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12000.00 | 4000.00 | day 10 | 8000.00 | 4.0 | 320.00 |
| 12000.00 | 4000.00 | day 20 | 12000.00 | 4.0 | 480.00 |
| 900.00 | none | — | 900.00 | 4.0 | 36.00, raised to the 50.00 minimum |
| 60000.00 | none | — | 60000.00 | 4.0 | 2400.00, held to the 1500.00 maximum |
